newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan CD rates 9.25-9.50 pct, 15 mln dinars offer.
newsitem.headline: Jordan CD rates 9.25-9.50 pct, 15 mln dinars offer.

text.p: Interest yields on Jordan's central bank certificates of deposit auction on Saturday were flat at 9.25 percent for three month CDs and 9.50 percent for six months, the bank said on Monday.
It gave no breakdown of the three- and six-month bills out of a total 15 million dinars ($21 million) offered. It said it will offer another 15 milion dinars in CDs at next Saturday's auction.
Repurchase agreements as collateral to weekly CDs remained at 10 percent with an unchanged 8.5-percent discount rate.
Outstanding CDs rose to 622 million dinars from 617.5 million dinars the previous week.
